# Meta Brand Collaboration Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/brand-collaboration-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/brand-collaboration-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.123**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract branded content partnerships from Meta Ad Library. Get creators, brand partners, content types, dates, and links from Instagram and Facebook. Enrich with profile and post details. Export data, schedule runs via API, and integrate with other tools or AI workflows workflows.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Result $0.0058 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/brand-collaboration-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-brand-collaboration-scraper@0.0.123#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | string[] | yes |  | 📕 Instagram/Facebook profile or Meta Library Branded Content URL — Two kinds of URL work here. 1) Profile URL — just paste an Instagram or Facebook profile, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/sephora/ or https://www.facebook.com/sephora/. The platform in the URL decides where collaborations are pulled  |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | 💯 Maximum posts/reels per URL — Set the maximum number of results you want to scrape. If you set it to 5, you'll get 5 results for each input URL you've included. ⚠️ If you leave this field empty, you will get as many results as possible. |
| `onlyPostsNewerThan` | string |  |  | Scrape content newer than — Scrape reels and posts from the provided date to the present day (or date set in 'Older than'). The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD absolute format or in relative format, e.g., 1 day, 2 months, 3 years. The JSON input also supports adding time units (UTC timezone): Full or p |
| `onlyPostsOlderThan` | string |  |  | Scrape content older than — Scrape branded content from the provided date to the past (or date set in 'Newer than'). The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO absolute format or in relative format e.g. 1 days, 2 months, 3 years. The JSON input also supports adding time units (UTC timezone): Full  |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string \| null | Unique ID of the branded content item. |
| `dateCreated` | string \| null | Date the branded content was created, in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| `creator` | object \| null | Creator of the branded content. |
| `brandPartners` | array \| null | List of brand partners featured in the collaboration. |
| `type` | string \| null | Content type of the branded collaboration (e.g. post, reel, story). |
| `link` | string \| null | URL to the branded content item. |
| `platform` | string \| null | Platform the branded content was published on, derived from the item's link. |
